mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_run) AS requestCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_run) AS successfulRequestCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_run) AS failedRequestCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_run) AS runningRequestCount, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS llmCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS successfulLlmCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS failedLlmCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_tool_call) AS toolCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_tool_call) AS successfulToolCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_tool_call) AS failedToolCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS promptTokens, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS completionTokens, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS totalTokens, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) FROM agent_llm_call) AS unknownTokenLlmCallCount, (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)), 0) FROM agent_run WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL) AS averageRunLatencyMs, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(latency_ms), 0) FROM agent_run WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL) AS maxRunLatencyMs

SELECT provider AS provider, model AS model, credential_source AS credentialSource, COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) AS llmCallCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successfulCallCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCallCount, COALESCE(SUM(prompt_tokens), 0) AS promptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(completion_tokens), 0) AS completionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN total_tokens IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknownTokenCallCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)), 0) AS averageLatencyMs FROM agent_llm_call GROUP BY provider, model, credential_source ORDER BY llmCallCount DESC, provider ASC, model ASC, credentialSource ASC

SELECT id, request_id, diagram_id, user_id, agent_id, session_id, request_type, credential_source, model_credential_id, status, error_class, started_at, completed_at, latency_ms, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_run_step s WHERE s.run_id = agent_run.id) AS step_count, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_llm_call c WHERE c.run_id = agent_run.id) AS llm_call_count, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_tool_call t WHERE t.run_id = agent_run.id) AS tool_call_count, (SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM agent_trace_event e WHERE e.run_id = agent_run.id) AS trace_event_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.total_tokens), 0) FROM agent_llm_call c WHERE c.run_id = agent_run.id) AS known_total_tokens FROM agent_run WHERE id = #{runId}
SELECT id, run_id, parent_id, user_id, phase, status, error_class, started_at, completed_at, latency_ms FROM agent_run_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, run_id, parent_id, user_id, phase, provider, model, credential_source, model_credential_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, status, error_class, started_at, completed_at, latency_ms FROM agent_llm_call WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, run_id, parent_id, user_id, phase, tool_name, status, error_class, started_at, completed_at, latency_ms FROM agent_tool_call WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, run_id, parent_id, request_id, user_id, sequence_no, event_type, phase, status, metadata_json, occurred_at FROM agent_trace_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, sequence_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_run SET user_id = #{anonymizedUserId}, model_credential_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE agent_llm_call SET user_id = #{anonymizedUserId}, model_credential_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId}
